title: Gauntlet - Dark Legacy
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 6194 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Action. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Warrior (strong melee), Valkyrie (balanced), Wizard (magic), Archer (fast, ranged), and more unlockable
widgets.label: Classes

widgets.text:
Health drains slowly over time, as in arcade Gauntlet.
Eat food to refill: do not shoot it!
widgets.label: Health

widgets.text:
Gold buys stat boosts: strength, armour, magic, speed.
The hero levels up with experience.
widgets.label: Level up

widgets.text:
Destroy the monster generators first: they spawn endlessly.
Death himself drains health: use magic or avoid him.
Potions clear the screen.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text:
Several realms, each with a hub of levels and a boss.
Keys open doors; exits lead deeper.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text:
Keys (doors), potions (screen-clearing magic), food (health), gold (stat shop).
Power-ups: rapid fire, reflect shots, speed, invisibility.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Runestones are hidden in the realms; collecting them opens the final area.
widgets.label: Hidden

widgets.text: Defeat each realm's boss and collect the runestones to face the final enemy.
widgets.label: Goal
